[h3]🎴 Adult Visual Novel × Hardcore Time Management🍷[/h3]

You are the new business mogul, and at the center of their desire vortex!
💃Joy Cafe, 👠Imperial Sister, 💼Partner, 🌙White Moonlight, 🖤Bad Woman. Behind the five beauties lies a scorching desire and secret.

Time is money! Between the battle of career and the lingering midnight, precisely allocate every minute. A single misstep could lead to total defeat!
[h3]👇 Speed up your wish list and embark on your journey as a time management master! [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427110/A_fascinating_story_2/
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎴 Core Play: Strategy Operation Heartbeat Romance 🍷[/h3]

Acquisition! "Invest!" Become the dominant player in the sex toy industry! Build your adult empire with business acumen. Wealth is the chip to conquer them.
The deep beauty interaction system unlocks intimate relationships through exclusive storylines and branching dialogues. Each female lead has a hidden story and special needs waiting for you to explore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37430609/8e77db934c58371f6fc54d9b153d44419534d9e5.png[/img]

Affection Item Shop 🏪 : make the most of your wealth! The game features a rich item store where you can purchase exclusive gifts, romantic props, and surprise arrangements that can enhance the favorability of specific characters. Skillfully cater to their preferences and accelerate the progress of your strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37430609/78d736c70cf69361c4c5079adcb9c9d9b749e34f.png[/img]

Multi-line Interaction and Deep Dating👩❤️👨: Navigate through multiple meticulously designed interactive scenarios (such as skyscrapers, luxurious dinner halls, secret clubs, cozy cafes, private mansions, etc.), and embark on a personalized date with the one you desire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37430609/5b5820302f05c82f4f72ea384d9453765f9b7222.png[/img]

Rich Event and Task-Driven📅: Triggering a multitude of achievable events and tasks! Resolving workplace crises, meeting their sudden requests, completing special invitations, and even getting caught up in unexpected controversies... Every choice affects the story's direction and character relationships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37430609/e182b48a4a6cbe59528ce612489a46c6c31b6471.png[/img]

Complete character story & ending CG🔚: Write your own ending for each one who has poured their heart and soul into it, collecting exclusive romantic (or thrilling) moments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37430609/5e5b2e2ddbceb397c080a4739aac12a3777487f3.png[/img]

❤️ Original Team + Surprising Easter Eggs 🎁: The main female character from the previous installment returns in surprise after experiencing a massive change in her life. Are they still the same as you remember them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37430609/abd8f918e0f1ede736de264341165669021c9463.jpg[/img]
